title: Cut what Susi does not use from Core's libraries, tests and config
goal: Core holds only what Susi's features use (AGENTS.md): an audit by grep found code, tests and config in susi-paths, susi-error and the root package that neither Susi nor Core's kept items reach

reuse.searched: Susi's src/, crates/ and tests/ at its Core pin f50e541d (crate code identical to Core main) for every public item of susi-paths and susi-error; Susi Tools for any use of Core; Core's own crates and root tests for internal callers
reuse.reason: A cut writes no new code: what stays is the existing code Susi's Windows crate calls (susi_paths::platform, susi_paths::console::background_command, susi_error::sink::append_metrics_line) and the four vendor wrappers
